enum class Mode { rgb, hex };
int select(Mode mode) { switch (mode) { case Mode::rgb: return 1; } return 0; }

enum class Mode { rgb, hex };
int select(Mode mode) { switch (mode) { case Mode::rgb: return 1; } return 0; }

enum class Mode { rgb, hex };
int select(Mode mode) { switch (mode) { case Mode::rgb: return 1; default: return 0; } }

enum class Mode { rgb, hex };
int select(Mode mode) { switch (mode) { case Mode::rgb: return 1; case Mode::hex: return 2; } return 0; }

struct Sample { int value; };
int mutate() { Sample sample{1}; sample.value = 2; return sample.value; }

struct Sample { int value; int read() const { return value; } };
int mutate() { Sample sample{1}; sample.value = 2; return sample.read(); }

class Sample { int value = 1; };
int mutate() { Sample sample; sample.value = 2; return 0; }
int read() { int value; return value; }

enum class Mode { rgb, hex };
Mode read() { return static_cast<Mode>(99); }

class Value { Value() = default; };
Value read() { return Value{}; }

class Value { int value; explicit Value(int input) : value(input) {} public: static Value make() { return Value(1); } int get() const { return value; } };
int read() { auto first = Value::make(); auto second = first; return second.get(); }

POINT read() { POINT value{}; GetCursorPos(&value); return value; }
